brief.note: Rising bond yields and AI-capex doubts hitting tech; Fabrinet fell despite record results. Prices are latest closes.

candidates.name: Cellebrite DI Ltd.
candidates.business: Digital forensics software used by police and agencies to extract phone evidence
candidates.cause: Cut 2026 revenue guidance to 15% growth, missed on annual recurring revenue, and replaced its chief executive in the same announcement.
candidates.right: New chief executive must stabilise recurring revenue and rebuild credibility on guidance
candidates.wrong: The ARR shortfall proves structural as police budgets tighten and rivals undercut

candidates.name: Fabrinet
candidates.business: Contract manufacturer of optical and photonic components for networking and data centres
candidates.cause: Beat on record Q4 revenue and earnings, but negative free cash flow, an inventory build and heavy planned capex overshadowed the result.
candidates.right: Cash generation must recover once the capex and inventory build works through
candidates.wrong: Datacom demand from its largest customers softens while margins stay under pressure

candidates.name: Pan American Silver Corp.
candidates.business: Silver and gold miner operating across Latin America and Canada
candidates.cause: Q2 adjusted EPS of $0.73 missed the $1.04 expected as gold output lagged guidance and the effective tax rate jumped to about 37%.
candidates.right: Gold output must return to guidance and the tax rate normalise next quarter
candidates.wrong: Metal prices roll over, turning a production stumble into a sustained earnings downgrade
